investigation_notes.Description: Vitalis Healthcare logo was detected on a suspicious domain, vitalis-portal-security.com, hosting a login page that imitates the Vitalis patient portal. The domain is newly registered (2 days) and resolves to IP 195.178.110.15, which has a high abuse reputation. The combination of brand impersonation, a credential-collection page, and a hosting environment with known risk indicates a credential phishing attempt rather than legitimate brand usage, warranting HP prioritization.
